title: Persist Announce TOFU pins and replay floors across Node restarts
description: P1 security: Node constructs AnnounceProcessor with fresh in-memory _pinned_keys and _seen tables and never includes them in LinkLayer or other crash-safe persistence. After restart a different first-seen key can replace the trust decision for an IID collision, and any old origin-signed Announce can be replayed through a currently authenticated relay because its fresh link counter does not protect the origin's 16-bit Announce sequence. This also leaves DaoOriginValidator without durable pre-pinned origin identities. Add fail-closed, rollback-resistant persistence for exact pubkey/IID pins and per-origin sequence floors, integrate it atomically with Node admission, and add reboot/corruption/relayed-stale tests.
